subject: maths
question:
The following figure shows the expenditures incurred by Rohan in different heads. Rohan has a monthly income of ₹50,000 out of which he spends 60% on different expenditures. What is the total expenditure (in ₹) incurred on Health, Education and Transportation together?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34bd70ec9b5e75e6001504c558c809a2fdaf332c05fe8f4eb282284d4e28b07b.png]
solution:
**Given:**

Monthly income = 50,000

He spends 60% on expenses

Expense(Health) = 24%

Expense(Education) = 18%

Expense(Transportation) = 14%

**Solution:**

60% of 50,000 = 30,000

now, 1% = 30,000/100 = 300

Expense(Health, Education and Transportation) = 24% + 18% + 14% = 56%

= 56 x 300 = 16,800.

**Hence, the total expense for Health, Education, and Transportation is Rs. 16,800.**
